INTRODUCTION: Learn the controls and head right into the farm.
EXPLORING: Answer the first question, then search for the hidden maize seed.
SEED_FOUND: Reach the farm plot and prepare the soil.
SOIL_PREPARED: Answer the planting question and plant the maize seed.
SEED_PLANTED: Visit the water source and give the crop enough water.
CROP_WATERED: Remove the weed and answer the crop-care question.
CROP_PROTECTED: Wait through the accelerated growth transition.
CROP_GROWING: The maize is growing. Stay ready to harvest.
CROP_HARVESTED: Take the maize to the mill for processing.
MAIZE_PROCESSED: Enter the kitchen and cook the maize meal.
MEAL_COOKED: Serve the completed meal at the final station.
